newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Dairy to merge with Land O' Lakes.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Dairy to merge with Land O' Lakes.

text.p: Atlantic Dairy Cooperative said Thursday its members approved a plan to merge with Land O'Lakes, setting in motion a formal merger of the two cooperatives effective April 1.
Land O'Lakes members voted in favor of the proposal Feb 20.
The merger, said the company, extends Land O'Lakes national production and marketing capabilities from coast to coast.
Headquartered in Arden Hills, Minn., Land O'Lakes is a food and agricultural cooperative that manufactures and markets a wide variety of food products.
